# Safety card missing privacy (Phase 14)

## Misuse and Malicious Use

Known risks of abuse include generating harassing content and dual-use social
engineering. Operators must block malicious use cases.

## Security Considerations

Security warnings: do not deploy without rate limits and monitoring for adversarial
inputs and prompt-injection attempts.

## Training Data

Trained on publicly documented datasets with source links and collection notes for
evaluation reproducibility.
